shadow_mode.description: Evaluate without sending replies (still calls the model)

allowed_groups.description: Exact platform_id|bot_id|group_id entries; empty enables no groups

persona_id.description: Existing persona ID; required, no fallback

attempt_interval.description: Minimum seconds between attempts, including silence and errors

reply_cooldown.description: Minimum seconds between local live replies

timeout.description: Total seconds for provider lookup, persona lookup and generation

max_groups.description: Maximum in-memory physical groups; excess groups fail closed
